business truth

attributionThrough the page, never the post. Links live on the Sift Page; sales are attributed on first and last click. No affiliate links or shop tags in the feed.
assets/official/BRAND.md#00
facesTwo faces, one engine. Sift Page in front: the machine finds every piece in a creator's posts, she keeps a few, the page is built in minutes. Sift Record behind: contract, post check, invoice and payment for her, her agency and the brand.

brand beliefs

aphorismTaste without the record becomes content. The record without taste becomes software. Together, they become infrastructure.
assets/official/BRAND.md#00
laws lockedShow the few, count the many. Every edit states its ratio., Nothing is deleted. What was left out stays on record., Red points at the one: the kept thing, the live state, the thing that needs you. Never decoration., No text on pictures, except the machine's own marks., Six at most. No view holds more than six chosen things., One typeface. Helvetica, everywhere., The record uses the same page as the edit. Denser, never a different world., Placeless. Never name the city Sift is built in.
assets/official/BRAND.md#00
public promises lockedNo taste score, ever., Disagreement is data., Every commercial tie is visible: organic, gifted, affiliate, paid., Your judgment is yours., Nothing is deleted quietly., Never discount codes, never dupes, commission never changes ranking.
